<entry id="I00019">
<head-word>טַב, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<head-word>טָבָא</head-word>
<head-word>טַבְתָא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>good, precious</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. II, 9.—Targ. II, Esth. I, 19 דטבא ed. Lag. (oth. ed. דטָבַת)—Targ. Jud. V, 26 (missing in ed. Lag.); a. v. fr.—Gen. R. s. 22; Lev. R. s. 22, v. בִּישׁ. Ber. 60
<sup>b</sup> כל מאי דעביד … לטב (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) whatever God does is for a good purpose. Tam. 32
<sup>a</sup> דידי טבא וכ' my advice is better than yours.—Lev. R. s. 33, beg. מינה ט' וכ' from it (the tongue) comes what is good &c.; a. v. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>worth, valued</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Keth. IV, end, 29
<sup>b</sup> חד בית בטב וכ' (ed. Krot. בדב, read: חד ביתא טב) a house worth &c. Ib. מכיון דלית ביתא טב וכ' as the house is not worth more than &c.—Y. Peah I, 15
<sup>d</sup> bot. מילא דט' דכוותה something of equal value; Gen. R. s. 35, end (corr. acc.); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>best man, elder, officer</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Taan. IV, 68
<sup>d</sup> top טב קרתא an officer of the town.—
<plural-form>Pl. טָבִין, טָבַיָּיא, טָבֵי;</plural-form> fem. טָבָתָא, טָבָאתָא, טָבָן. Targ. Mic. VII, 1. Targ. Ps. CXXV, 4; a. fr.—B. Mets. 44
<sup>b</sup> שלים לה ט' וכ' pay her in good and full-weight coin. Y. Snh. X, 28
<sup>b</sup> bot. כל טָבָן וכ', v. נֶחֶמְתָּא. Lam. R. to I, 1 רבתי (חד מאת' 1) טבאתא the good fruits; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (adv.) 
<italic>much, more</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Prov. XVII, 10.—Gitt. 14
<sup>b</sup> טב טב רמו ליה Ar. (ed. only one טב) strike him more (or, 
<italic>it is right</italic>, v. Rashi a. l.)—Y. Shek. IV, 48
<sup>a</sup> top, v. טָבָאוּת.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>in a</italic>)

<xref rid="A00083">הֵיטֵב)</xref></language-reference>.</definition>

<sup>a</sup> bot. אין אתא הא ט' if he appears, it is well. Y. Shek. IV, 48
<sup>a</sup> top וטבות כן Bab. ed. (Y. ed. וטבא) and so it is right. Y. Maas. Sh. I, 52
<sup>d</sup> top וטבבו כן (corr. acc.)—Hebr. form: טָּבִית. Meïl. 17
<sup>a</sup> ט' אמר he spoke well (he is right).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="I00041">
<head-word>טָבַח</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, (b. h.) 
<italic>to prepare a feast</italic>, esp. 
<italic>to slaughter and dress meat, to cook</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 4
<sup>a</sup> טִבְחוֹ טָבוּחַ his meat for the feast is ready (for cooking).—Bets. 25
<sup>a</sup> (expl. בית טביחה) מקום שטוֹבַחַת וכ' the place where the animal cooks (digests) its food.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<head-word>טְבַח</head-word>
<language-key>ch.</language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes>Ber. 56
<sup>a</sup> טַבְחַת ולא אכלת thou shalt prepare and not eat. Sabb. 129
<sup>b</sup> הוה ט' להו וכ' it (the wind or demon טָבוֹחַ) would have feasted on them (the Israelites), on their flesh and their blood; a. e.—V. 
<xref rid="M00963">מַטְבְּחַיָּיא</xref></notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>טַבַּח</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>

<notes> same. Gen. R. s. 57, end טבח טַבְּחוֹן Tabaḥ (Gen. XXII, 24) means, ‘Slaughter them’ v. 
<xref rid="C00594">גַּחֲמוֹן</xref></notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<plural-form>Pl. טַבָּחִים</plural-form>. Kidd. IV, 14; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="I00050">
<head-word>טַבְיָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (= h. צְבִי) 
<italic>deer, gazelle</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Deut. XII, 15; a. fr.—Snh. 95
<sup>a</sup>. Ḥull. 59
<sup>b</sup>, v. קֶרֶשׁ II; a. e.—Ib. 59

<plural-form>Pl. טָבַיָּא, טַבְיֵי</plural-form>. Targ. II Sam. II, 18; a. e.—Keth. 103
<sup>b</sup> וצידנא טביא (Rashi: וצדיינא טביי) and I caught deer.—Fem. pl. טָבְיָן, טַבְיַן. Targ. I Kings V, 3. Targ. Y. Deut. XIV, 5.—Y. Snh. VII, end, 25
<sup>d</sup>.—[Y. Ter. IX, end, 48
<sup>b</sup> מה טבייה, v. טִיב I ch.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>b</sup>. Men. 70
<sup>a</sup> ט' בר קיסנא (Ms. M. טובי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).—Gen. R. s. 4. Ex. R. s. 93, end.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<head-word>טְבִיחָה</head-word>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (טָבַח) </definition>

<definition>
<italic>slaughtering;</italic></definition>

<sup>c</sup> top ט' שחרית.—Tosef. Yad. II, 20 טובלי שחרין (Var. טוֹבְלָנֵי) morning bathers (Essenes, v. Graetz Gesch. d. Jud. III
<sup>2</sup>, p. 468, a. for correct vers. R. S. to Yad. IV, 8).—
<italic>Part. pass</italic>. טָבוּל.—טְבוּל יום (one who has bathed in day-time,) 
<italic>one who has bathed but must wait for sunset to be perfectly clean</italic> (Lev. XXII, 7). T’bul Yom I, 1; a. fr.—Nidd. 30
<sup>a</sup> טְבוּלַת יום ארוך a woman after bathing whose day is adjourned (having to wait a long time for perfect levitical purity).—טְבוּל יוֹם

<italic>Tahăroth</italic></notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-form>טִיבֵּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>

<italic>to dip into vinegar, salt &c., to make tasty;</italic> esp. 
<italic>to take a luncheon, to take the first course of a meal consisting of relishes; to take the antepast.</italic></definition>
<notes> Maasr. IV, 1 המְטַבֵּל בשדה he who makes a luncheon (of fruits) in the field. Pes. X, 3 מטבל בחזרת he takes lettuce as antepast. Tosef. ib. X, 9 לא טי' וכ' if he has eaten as antepast only &c. Pes. 107
<sup>b</sup> אבל מטבל וכ' Ms. M. a. comment. (ed. מטביל) but he may make a luncheon of &c. Ib. השמש מטבל בבני וכ' comment. (ed. מטביל; Tosef. ib. X, 5 מכביש, v. כָּבַשׁ); a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<italic>to season with spices.</italic></definition>
<notes>
<italic> Part. pass</italic>. מְטוּבָּל. Y. Shek. III, 47
<sup>c</sup> top מבושל כמ' boiled (wine) is (in ritual law) like spiced wine; v. infra.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>

<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>

<italic>to immerse</italic> vessels for purification, 
<italic>to order immersion.</italic></definition>

<sup>b</sup>), v. גַּב.—Nidd. 29
<sup>b</sup>, v. טְבִילָה; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to take luncheon</italic>, v. supra.</definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to season</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. 28
<sup>b</sup> מטבילין בו וכ' they used to season the roast with it (in place of pepper).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּטְבָּל</binyan-form>
